metadata.description: Name of the environment (used for resource naming)
Primary location for all resources
Base name used to derive default resource names (e.g. "ci" -> "ci-app", "ci-app-env"). Keep stable across runs to make CD idempotent.
Resource group name. Defaults to "<baseName>-app-rg". Override via RESOURCE_GROUP_NAME env var.
Container App name (the FQDN segment before the ACA env domain). Defaults to "<baseName>-app".
Container Apps managed environment name. Its default domain is generated by Azure and is preserved across runs as long as the env is reused.
Container Registry name (alphanumeric only). Defaults to a deterministic value derived from baseName.
User-assigned managed identity name. Defaults to "<baseName>-app-identity".
Log Analytics workspace name. Defaults to "<baseName>-app-logs".
Id of the user or app to assign application roles
Principal type: User or ServicePrincipal
Existing Azure OpenAI endpoint (if reusing)
Existing Azure OpenAI chat deployment name
Existing Azure OpenAI embedding deployment name
Existing Azure OpenAI resource ID (required when the account lives in another resource group or subscription)
Existing PostgreSQL host (if reusing)
Existing PostgreSQL database name
Existing PostgreSQL username
Existing PostgreSQL password
PostgreSQL admin password (required if NOT using existing)
PostgreSQL database name
Azure AD Frontend Client ID
Azure AD Frontend Tenant ID
Azure AD API Tenant ID
Azure AD API App ID
Azure AD API Audience
Disable authentication
Hierarchy linker mode: auto (on if model file is present), on (force-enable), off
Confidence threshold for auto-link (else queued for review)
Confidence threshold for sending to review queue (below this, no link)
When true, ML decisions are computed and logged but not persisted
Provision the nightly hierarchy linker retrain Container Apps Job
Cron schedule (UTC) for the nightly retrain job
Minimum reviewer-confirmed positives before the retrain job actually retrains
Azure region
Base name prefix used for all resources
Common tags to apply
Container Apps environment id
Azure Container Registry name (used for the registry login)
Container image (full path), if empty the job is provisioned but inactive
User-assigned managed identity resource id (for ACR pull + Postgres AAD)
User-assigned managed identity client id
Cron expression (UTC). Default: 03:17 every day
Whether the schedule trigger is enabled
Minimum reviewer-confirmed positives required before retraining proceeds
Whether to skip the job entirely (e.g. when no model is set up yet)
